title: Line Goes Up – The Problem With NFTs
summary: Long-form critique of crypto, NFTs, play-to-earn and DAOs as greater-fool markets built on 2008-era grievances, where early holders profit from artists and late buyers.

assertions.quote: more would always go to those with the resources to build the bigger rig

verdicts.note: Mining economics scale with capital and cheap power; hash rate is dominated by large industrial operations and pools.

assertions.quote: every dollar that comes out of cryptocurrency needs to come from a later investor putting a dollar in

verdicts.note: True for pure token trading net of fees and mining costs, but overstated for assets with any real utility or cash flow.

Blockchain holdings data show a market sustained by new entrants and small holders buying as prices rise while early investors, miners and whales cash out at their expense, and the paper notes the system largely does not finance real-world investment; consistent with the later-buyer mechanism though no zero-sum accounting is done.

assertions.quote: tons of the tokens did little more than point to images stored on normal servers

verdicts.note: Most ERC-721 metadata referenced HTTP or IPFS URLs; link rot and swapped images were documented repeatedly.

assertions.quote: royalties are easily bypassed simply by using a Marketplace that doesn't collect royalties

verdicts.note: Major marketplaces made creator royalties optional in 2022-2023 and royalty income collapsed, confirming they were never on-chain enforced.

assertions.quote: hundreds of thousands of artists bought in only to find that there wasn't a new revolutionary highly trafficked audience of digital art collectors

verdicts.note: Market analyses found most NFTs sold for trivial sums or not at all and trading was concentrated among a small set of wallets, though a minority of artists did earn meaningful sums.

assertions.quote: wash trading where you sell something to your own sock puppets in order to lure in real buyers

verdicts.note: Blockchain analytics firms found wash trades made up a large share of NFT volume on several marketplaces in 2021-2022.

assertions.quote: doubters are ostracized so aggressively that it chills all conversation about a Project's actual viability

verdicts.note: A description of community norms and framing rather than a measurable outcome.

assertions.quote: there's no Authority you can report them to that has the power to return your tokens

verdicts.note: Transactions are final by design; recovery depends on marketplace delisting, ransom or rare exchange cooperation.

assertions.quote: the Payday for failure makes it irrational to succeed

verdicts.note: Mint proceeds are collected up front and rug pulls were common, though reputational effects do push some teams to deliver.

assertions.quote: an infinite supply of new players must enter the ecosystem forever purely to keep the price stable

verdicts.note: The leading play-to-earn game's reward token lost most of its value in 2022 once new-player growth stopped.

assertions.quote: all but the highest ranking players fell below the average daily wage in the Philippines

verdicts.note: Reporting and economy analyses documented sub-minimum-wage earnings after the 2021 downturn, though earlier earnings had briefly exceeded local wages.

assertions.quote: the transaction fees on popular chains are so prohibitive that it's pointless to use them on any transaction that isn't hundreds if not thousands

verdicts.note: Accurate for Ethereum mainnet and Bitcoin at the time; later layer-2 networks and other chains cut fees to cents.

The paper states cryptocurrencies have not proven useful for real payments or transfers, but attributes this to price volatility and limited transaction capacity (citing Boissay et al) rather than fees per se; it also notes lower mining capacity raises fees.

assertions.quote: you might think you're being recruited to pump but you're actually the dump

verdicts.note: Studies of Telegram and Discord pump groups found organizers and early insiders profit while later participants lose.
